title: Gemini voice limits: session, quiet time, daily cap, fallback (manual until automated)

clauses.text: The session length (default 600 seconds), the quiet time (30 seconds) and the daily microphone cap (1800 seconds) are set and shown.

steps.do: Open Settings, Gemini voice (experimental) and read the values and the status row.
steps.expect: They show the defaults: session length 600 seconds, closing after 30 seconds of quiet, and a daily microphone cap of 1800 seconds with a meter for the day.

clauses.text: An open session closes after 30 seconds of quiet.

steps.do: With the yes given and a session open, stay quiet for 30 seconds.
steps.expect: The session closes and the red band goes out.

clauses.text: Stop now ends every open session at once.

steps.do: Start a session, then press x (Stop now) on the page.
steps.expect: The session ends and the microphone closes at once. Nothing more is sent.

clauses.text: When Google's limit is reached, the message says plainly that the free limit is reached.

steps.do: Only if Google's limit is reached during use, read the message on the page. If it never happens, mark this clause cannot-test.
steps.expect: The message says plainly that the free limit is reached.

clauses.text: With no key, no yes, no network or a refusal, the local voice answers and a one-line reason is given.

steps.do: With the yes not given, ask the voice assistant a question.
steps.expect: The local voice answers, and a one-line reason for not using Gemini is shown.
